 Order

1. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 338/2021 of PS New Friends Colony for offence under Section 323/377/406/498A/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2)
has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
2. Learned proxy counsel for petitioners seeks adjournment on the ground that the arguing counsel is not available today.
3. As requested, relist on 04.08.2026 in Advance List.
